tickets.title: Skip Day quota is spent by days the user never opened the app
tickets.name: D-29 [Major] Skip Day quota is spent by days the user never opened the app
tickets.notes:
Area: Dashboard / Skip Day. Found: while fixing D-06, 10 Sep 2026.

Not observed in the beta run - found by reading the code during the D-06 fix, and it is the
most likely explanation for what the beta run DID see.

MECHANISM
getSkipDayCount (apps/server/src/resolvers/routine.js:40-59) counts how many days this week
the user has skipped, and skipRoutine (routine.js:436) refuses with "You have already skip 2
days this week." once that count reaches 2.

The helper treats a MISSING routine document as a skipped day (selectedItem === null, line 53).
A routine document is only created when the user actually opens the app for that date. So every
day the user simply did not open the app silently spends their weekly Skip Day quota.

EFFECT
A user who misses two days of a week - by being on holiday, ill, or just not opening the app -
can no longer use Skip Day at all for the rest of that week. The one feature intended to handle
"I could not do my routine today" is disabled precisely by the situation it exists for.

The refusal was also invisible until now: skipClick's catch showed a generic "An unexpected
error occured" and reverted the switch, which is exactly why D-06 was filed as "the Skip Day
switch does nothing". D-06's fix now surfaces the real server message, so this defect is at
least legible - but the quota rule itself is unchanged.

DONE WHEN
A day the user never opened the app is not counted against the Skip Day quota, OR the quota
rule is deliberately confirmed as intended and the UI explains it before the user hits it.

NOTE
This is a product decision as much as a bug - changing getSkipDayCount alters the weekly quota
for every existing user, which is why the D-06 fix deliberately did not touch it.

tickets.title: An agent can only ever be started once per routine item
tickets.name: D-05 [Major] An agent can only ever be started once per routine item
tickets.notes:
Area: Agents. Found: days 1 and 7.

ACTUAL
Day 1's "Start agent" succeeded and debited 15 diamonds; the agent moved to listening. Day 7's "Start agent" failed with a red toast - "Error / Could not redeem this task. Please try again." No diamonds debited, agent unchanged.

CAUSE
The routine-item document carries redeemed: true (confirmed in the apps/server log alongside ticked: true). Routine items are one shared document reused across every day, so the flag set on 16 Aug is still true on 22 Aug and the redeem is refused permanently.

EFFECT
A "daily" agent runs exactly one day, then errors forever.

SECONDARY
The error message says "redeem this task", which does not match the button the user pressed ("Start agent"), so the user cannot tell what failed or why.

DONE WHEN
The redeem/started flag is scoped per day, and the error names the action that actually failed.
